entities.name: Tracking Area Updating Procedure
entities.description: UE-initiated procedure used for updating registration, periodic notification, inter-system changes, parameter updates, and recovery from errors.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network in response to tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: EMM Cause
entities.description: Information element indicating reason for rejection or failure.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE
entities.description: Substate where UE is attempting to update registration.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM
entities.description: Substate where UE is attempting to update mobility management.

entities.name: T3245
entities.description: Timer started when PLMN is forbidden.

entities.name: T3402
entities.description: Timer related to tracking area updating attempts.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: Timer related to tracking area updating attempts.

entities.name: Tracking Area Updating Attempt Counter
entities.description: Counter limiting number of rejected tracking area update attempts.

entities.name: UE attached for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where UE is attached for emergency services.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT EPS optimization not used
entities.description: Condition where control plane CIoT EPS optimization is not active.

relations.description: Tracking area updating procedure can be initiated in EMM-IDLE mode.
Tracking area updating procedure can be initiated in EMM-CONNECTED mode.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message contains EMM Cause IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT with EMM cause #11 starts timer T3245.
Successful tracking area updating procedure resets the attempt counter.
Counter reset when UE is in EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE and certain conditions occur.
Counter reset when UE is in EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM and certain conditions occur.
Expiry of timer T3402 resets the tracking area updating attempt counter.
Starting timer T3346 resets the tracking area updating attempt counter.
When UE is attached for emergency services, network shall not indicate certain features in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT.
When control plane CIoT EPS optimization is not used, UE may request re-establishment of radio and S1 bearers during TAU.
